sources.title: WebGPU Overview — React Three Fiber v10
sources.version_context: R3F v10 documentation deployment; page identifies v10+ and React 19 requirement; alpha context confirmed by migration page.
sources.evidence: Explains default WebGPURenderer Canvas, WebGL2 backend fallback, renderer entry points, TSL compatibility, and why GLSL ShaderMaterial requires the legacy renderer.

sources.title: v10 Migration Guide — React Three Fiber
sources.version_context: v10 alpha migration guide; states three >=0.185.0 and React >=19.0 <19.4.
sources.evidence: Documents alpha status, default WebGPURenderer, /legacy import for GLSL/WebGL-only libraries, breaking changes, and migration checklist.

sources.title: TSL Hooks — React Three Fiber
sources.evidence: Defines useUniforms, useNodes, useLocalNodes, scopes, graph generations, dynamic uniform updates, and graph rebuild behavior.

sources.title: Render Pipeline — React Three Fiber
sources.version_context: R3F v10 docs; notes Three.js renamed PostProcessing to RenderPipeline in r183.
sources.evidence: Documents useRenderPipeline ownership, automatic scene pass creation, MRT, outputNode, cleanup, persisted pipelines, callback execution, and pass disposal caveat.

sources.title: Compute (Buffers & Storage) — React Three Fiber
sources.version_context: R3F v10 documentation; page explicitly labels useBuffers/useGPUStorage experimental.
sources.evidence: Documents GPU buffers, storage textures, compute hooks, particle example, and explicit disposal methods; warns APIs may change.

sources.title: WebGPURenderer — Three.js Manual
sources.version_context: Current manual accessed 2026-11-01; RenderPipeline naming aligned with r183 docs.
sources.evidence: Explains WebGPU-to-WebGL2 backend fallback, TSL transpilation to WGSL/GLSL, unsupported ShaderMaterial/onBeforeCompile and EffectComposer, and experimental status.

sources.title: TSL — Three.js API Documentation
sources.evidence: Reference for TSL nodes and material properties, including uniforms and PBR-related node functions.

sources.title: FunctionNode — Three.js API Documentation
sources.evidence: Documents native shader function nodes, including wgslFn and glslFn, and their language-specific function source.

sources.title: ShaderMaterial — Three.js API Documentation
sources.evidence: Explicitly states ShaderMaterial can only be used with WebGLRenderer and documents GLSL shader/uniform behavior.

sources.title: GLTFLoader — Three.js API Documentation
sources.evidence: Lists GLTFLoader-supported glTF extensions and warns that ImageBitmap resources need special disposal handling.

sources.title: glTF 2.0 — Blender 5.4 Manual
sources.version_context: Blender 5.4 manual; official page indexed by search. Direct page open returned an access error during retrieval.
sources.evidence: Describes recognized Principled BSDF material export, texture channel expectations, emissive/clearcoat/transmission/volume and other supported glTF extensions.

sources.title: glTF 2.0 Specification
sources.evidence: Defines metallic-roughness PBR material representation, texture color-space and channel conventions, extension declarations, and asset interchange semantics.

sources.title: Post-Processing with WebGPURenderer — Three.js Manual
sources.evidence: Explains RenderPipeline replacing EffectComposer, TSL node-composed effects, MRT and attachment precision/bandwidth considerations.
